name: The Abbott and Costello Show
description: Bud and Lou are unemployed actors living in Mr. Fields’ boarding house. Lou’s girlfriend Hillary lives across the hall. Many situations arise leading to slapstick and puns.

videos.title: "Hey Abbott!" 1978 TV Special - Hosted by Milton Berle
videos.overview:
This is technically not a movie, but a movie-length TV special that originally aired in the late 1970's. Milton Berle introduces a series of very well-chosen excerpts from Abbott & Costello's TV series (not their movies). Additional commentaries by Joe Besser and Steve Allen are also included.

Many of the best burlesque comedy skits ever performed are featured in their entirety: "Slowly I Turn", "Herd of Cows", "Floogle Street", "Who's On First", and many others. The narration is by Milton Berle. This tape is a non-stop laugh riot all the way through! Abbott & Costello made many good movies through the 1940's and 1950's, but in my opinion even the best of them fall short of the laugh quotient of this superb compilation. With this tape, you don't have to sit through plot-advancing scenes or musical numbers while you wait for the funny parts. Pretty much the whole thing is the funny parts!

videos.title: The Drug Store
videos.overview: Bud and Lou find jobs in Fields' drugstore and nearly wreck the place. This episode opens with the famous "Jonah and the Whale" routine.

videos.title: The Dentist's Office
videos.overview: When Lou gets a toothache he attempts to get arrested so he can receive free treatment while incarcerated.

videos.title: Jail
videos.overview: Lou damages Mrs. Crumbcake's waterpail and she drags him into court claiming .79 cents in damages. In jail, Lou's crazed cellmate becomes enraged whenever he hears "Niagara Falls."

videos.title: The Vacation
videos.overview: Bud and Lou head off to the Biltmore Hotel near Phoenix for a vacation. "Hertz U-Drive" and the "Pack-Unpack" routines are performed.

videos.title: The Birthday Party
videos.overview: Lou throws a birthday party for himself, but nearly poisons his guests when he puts ant paste on his hors d'oeurves instead of anti pasto. Bud throws him out and Lou consoles himself by ordering a giant decorated cake.

videos.title: Alaska
videos.overview: When news arrives that Lou's uncle has struck gold in Alaska, Bud and Lou plan to help him spend it.

videos.title: The Vacuum Cleaner Salesman
videos.overview: Bud and Lou visit an employment agency run by Mr. Fields' brother, who gives Lou a job selling vacuum cleaners door to door.

videos.title: The Army Story
videos.overview: Bud and Lou join the Army, where they recreate their routines from the feature film 'Buck Privates.' "Drill Routine" and "Dice Game" are performed.

videos.title: Pots and Pans
videos.overview: Working as a door-to-door cookware salesman, Lou prepares a dinner for his friends in hopes of moving some product. However, his honest culinary efforts are met with disaster.

videos.title: The Charity Bazaar
videos.overview: Bud and Lou participate in Hillary's charity bazaar, raising money with the "shell game." Lou blows his money at the kissing booth.

videos.title: The Western Story
videos.overview: Bud and Lou accept Hillary's invitation to visit her uncle's B-Bar-Bop ranch.

videos.title: The Haunted House
videos.overview: Hillary will inherit a castle if she spends one night there. Bud and Lou come along with her for protection and Lou is scared out of his mind by frightful encounters.

videos.title: Peace and Quiet
videos.overview: Lou sleeps all day but can't sleep at night. Bud takes him to see a psychiatrist. Eventually Bud checks him into a sanitarium for a night's rest. "Crazy House" is performed.

videos.title: Hungry
videos.overview: Bud and Lou visit a couple of restaurants. In one they become involved with twin waitresses. In the other, Lou has a battle with an oyster.

videos.title: The Music Lovers
videos.overview: Lou attempts to impress Hillary and her father with his musical abilities. While pretending to perform, Bud falls asleep and ruins the scheme.

videos.title: The Politician
videos.overview: Bud coaches Lou on running for public office, a political campaign that ends with Lou delivering a disastrous speech in a neighborhood park.

videos.title: The Wrestling Story
videos.overview: Lou and Stinky agree to settle their differences with a wrestling match. When Stinky becomes ill, his little brother Ivan the Terrible takes his place.

videos.title: Getting a Job
videos.overview: Bud and Lou are hired to deliver hats to the Susquehanna Hat Company on Floogle Street and encounter several lunatics on the way. Also, Stinky attempts to kill Lou by backing him into traffic. The "Loafing" routine is performed.

videos.title: Bingo the Chimp
videos.overview: Mike the Cop tells Lou that he must have a license for his pet chimp. But Lou accidentally applies for a marriage license.

videos.title: Hillary's Birthday
videos.overview: While shopping for Hillary's birthday present, Lou nearly destroys a grocery store. Later, at her party, Mr. Fields becomes upset about the noise.

videos.title: The Television Show
videos.overview: Lou is a contestant on a TV quiz show where he wins a pack of bubblegum. Their neighbor slips on a piece of gum and takes them to court.

videos.title: Las Vegas
videos.overview: Bud and Lou pay $90 for a car and head for Las Vegas, where Lou takes part in a violent game of billiards. The "mudder/fodder" routine is performed.

videos.title: Little Old Lady
videos.overview: Bud and Lou attempt to help an old lady who has been evicted. They raise $300 and she uses the money to bet on a racehorse.

videos.title: The Actors' Home
videos.overview: Bud is taken away to an old actors' home where he and Lou perform their famous "Who's on first?" routine.

videos.title: Police Rookies
videos.overview: Mike the Cop helps Bud and Lou enroll in the Police Rookie School, where Lou blows up the gymnasium while playing with a hand grenade.

videos.title: Safari
videos.overview: When Bingo gets sick, the whole gang travels to Africa to find his parents.

videos.title: The Paper Hangers
videos.overview: To pay back rent, Bud and Lou attempt to wallpaper an apartment. Later, as waiters in a restaurant, they brawl with hoodlums.

videos.title: Uncle Bozzo's Visit
videos.overview: Lou's eccentric opera singing uncle comes to stay with the boys for a couple of months.

videos.title: In Society
videos.overview: A wealthy society matron pays Bud to attend a formal reception and impersonate the Duke of Gluten. Lou comes along pretending to be his cousin, the Earl of Waldo.

videos.title: Life Insurance
videos.overview: Mr. Fields takes out an insurance policy on Lou. Later, Bud takes Lou on a hunting trip, and Lou suspects Bud and Mr. Fields have plotted to kill him for the insurance money.

videos.title: Pest Exterminators
videos.overview: Bud and Lou are pest exterminators mistaken for psychiatrists when they attend to Mrs. Featherton's "aunts."

videos.title: Killer's Wife
videos.overview: When a heavyweight prize fighter named Killer thinks that Lou is having an affair with his wife, Bud attempts to get Lou trained and fit in a gym.

videos.title: Cheap Skates
videos.overview: Bud and Lou accidentally buy a crate of roller-skates, not knowing that they have stolen diamonds hidden inside.

videos.title: South of Dixie
videos.overview: Lou accidentally lands himself and Bud roles in a Civil War melodrama.

videos.title: From Bed to Worse
videos.overview: Bud and Lou attempt to plant a backyard garden in order to win a cash prize offered by a civic group.

videos.title: $1,000 TV Prize
videos.overview: Lou wins a $1,000 dollar prize pretending to be Mr. Fields. He then has to get Mr. Fields out of the way so he can collect it.

videos.title: Amnesia
videos.overview: Lou is in love with a girl he has never met. As a gag, Bud and his friends convince him that he has already married the girl. The woman who poses as his wife then makes his existence miserable.

videos.title: Efficiency Experts
videos.overview: Bud and Lou land jobs as efficiency experts, and are assigned to restrain their client’s daughters from spending money. The young women, however, get the boys to buy them expensive dresses and take them to a casino, where they end up in a brawl.

videos.title: Car Trouble
videos.overview: When Lou wins a car, Bud sells it to buy a cheaper one, using the profits to try to finance a vacation in Flint, Michigan.

videos.title: Wife Wanted
videos.overview: When Lou finds out he will inherit $10,000 provided that he has a wife, he tries to marry a former girlfriend—who is dating a man named Bonebender Brodsky.

videos.title: Uncle from New Jersey
videos.overview: When Mr. Fields is just about to evict the boys, Bud convinces him that Lou's Uncle Ruppert is a millionaire and Lou is the sole heir. Complications arise, however, when Mike the Cop begins to believe that the visiting uncle (Lou in disguise) has been murdered.

videos.title: Private Eye
videos.overview: After receiving his private eye diploma from the Watchdog Correspondence School, Lou helps a friend locate some valuable bonds in a haunted house.

videos.title: The Tax Return
videos.overview: Lou receives a tax refund check for $1,000,000. He takes the check to a bank and demands cash. He is subsequently followed by home by crooks.

videos.title: Public Enemies
videos.overview: Lou is mistaken for a crook named Dapper Dan and is forced to take part in a robbery.

videos.title: Bank Holdup
videos.overview: Bud and Lou unwittingly take jobs as armed bodyguards for a couple of hoodlums and assist in a bank robbery. They use their share of money to pay their rent, and later try to get it back from Mr. Fields' safe.

videos.title: Well Oiled
videos.overview: Bud and Lou help Mr. Fields, who is being threatened with a lawsuit. Lou poses as a Texas millionaire to help discredit the complainant.

videos.title: The Pigeon
videos.overview: Bud and Lou's beautiful next door neighbor uses Lou as a decoy to help break up with her mobster boyfriend.

videos.title: Honeymoon House
videos.overview: When Bud and Mr. Fields help Lou put together a prefab house in order to impress his fiancée and her parents, a jealous former boyfriend sabotages their work.

videos.title: Fencing Master
videos.overview: A mad scientist's experiment convinces Lou that he is indestructible.

videos.title: Beauty Contest Story
videos.overview: When Bud and Lou judge a beauty contest, pressure is applied to sway their votes.

videos.title: Fall Guy
videos.overview: Bud and Lou want to take two sisters on a date but their father convinces the boys to put an antenna on his roof instead.

videos.title: Barber Lou
videos.overview: Lou tries to give Bud a rubdown following instructions from a radio show, but he's tuned into a program explaining how to paint a car at home.
